_comment: Map these CSS selectors to YOUR ZSmart v9 instance using DevTools (F12 -> right-click element -> Copy selector). ZSmart deployments differ, so these ship as best-guess placeholders. Each field accepts an array of selectors; the first one that matches wins. Leave an array empty to skip a field. The extension still works without any of these via the 'visible text' and 'selection' fallback capture modes.
frameHint: ZSmart usually renders modules in iframes. The content script runs in all frames automatically; selectors are evaluated per-frame.
